data.change_summary: Added entry photo-eye jam detection per narrative section 3 and cause-effect CE-ST10-03: timer T10 (5.0 s, K50) runs when conveyor motor Y10 is running and entry eye X11 is blocked. Upon timer done (T10), jam alarm M190 is latched via SET. M190 trips fault interlock M199 to stop Y10 and clears via reset PB X1.
data.program_il:
; ST10_CONVEYOR (FX5U) - converted from FX3U project CV_ST1_V2, 2019

# R0
LDI    X13
OUT    M191             ; ST10 motor overload alarm

# R1
LD     X1
RST    M190

# R2
LD     M190
OR     M191             ; ST10 motor overload alarm
ORI    X0               ; ES-0001 E-stop chain healthy
OUT    M199

# R3
LD     X2               ; SS-0003 auto mode
ANI    M199
OUT    Y10

# R4
LD     Y10
AND    X11              ; PE-1002 conveyor entry photo-eye
OUT    T10 K50          ; jam_time 5.0 s

# R5
LD     T10
SET    M190             ; ST10 jam alarm

# R6
LD     X10
OUT    M100             ; ST10 pallet in position

# R7
LDP    X14              ; RQ-1005 release request
SET    Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release

# R8
LD     Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release
OUT    T11 K20

# R9
LD     T11
RST    Y11              ; XY-1004 stopper release

END
